Black cloth topknot/headwrap with two tied cloth tails, black cloth nose/mouth mask, visible alert brown eyes, charcoal gray cross-over long sleeve tunic, plain brown cloth waist sash, charcoal trousers, tan-crossed dark shinwraps and small black cloth boots. Empty hands/arms relaxed. Neutral mild fatigue. Clothing rendered restrained hand-painted texture.

His nearest leg extends downward on the RIGHT side of the image with its boot planted LOW on the RIGHT; the other leg remains behind on the LEFT, bending slightly with its LEFT boot lightly raised above and to the left of the grounded right boot. Right boot at(x760,y1120), left boot at(x520,y980). This forms feet diagonally from upper-left to lower-right, NOT lower-left to upper-right. Both toes point LEFT toward screen-down-left. Both chest and face remain turned left. The two legs must NOT cross or overlap into one straight shin. Natural adult knees with only a small step, no crouch/hunch/high-knee/squat/run. Exactly one man centered full-body with generous alpha margins; native square max1536, figure about75–80% canvas height. Genuine transparent alpha background.
